questions.question: Which statement correctly explains enterprise selection?
options: avoid monitoring and keeping records of the activity
select and apply a suitable practice while considering safety, sustainability and farm conditions
ignore local conditions and the needs of the crop or animal
use an unsafe practice that can damage the product or resource
questions.explanation: The correct response is to select and apply a suitable practice while considering safety, sustainability and farm conditions. This applies the concept of enterprise selection within the Grade 9 sub-strand Agricultural enterprise planning.
